subject: mathematics
content: Let $$\theta$$ be the angle between the planes $$P_{1}: \vec{r} \cdot(\hat{i}+\hat{j}+2 \hat{k})=9$$ and $$P_{2}: \vec{r} \cdot(2 \hat{i}-\hat{j}+\hat{k})=15$$. Let $$\mathrm{L}$$ be the line that meets $$P_{2}$$ at the point $$(4,-2,5)$$ and makes an angle $$\theta$$ with the normal of $$P_{2}$$. If $$\alpha$$ is the angle between $$\mathrm{L}$$ and $$P_{2}$$, then $$\left(\tan ^{2} \theta\right)\left(\cot ^{2} \alpha\right)$$ is equal to ____________.
